summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for jhax.ai. 8/8 pytest backend tests pass covering research (Gemini live search), list/get/delete, snapshot SSE stream (persisted with is_snapshot=true), chat SSE stream with verified conversation continuity (recall test of number 4271 worked). Frontend E2E: landing form -> researching-state -> chat view -> snapshot-message streamed (1164 chars), profile sidebar shows cuisine/price/rating/competitors, tools panel toggled and Prime Cost calculator returned 62.0%, chat-input + chat-send-button produced assistant-message, reset-button returns to landing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_chat/build_search_chat accept a search_ctx param that is unused - minor dead param.
research endpoint has no timeout guard; if Gemini takes long the request will hang the client. Consider server-side timeout with graceful fallback.

SSE gen() catches error broadly but the 'yield sse(error)' happens inside try - if error occurs after streaming started, still fine; consider not persisting empty assistant messages (already handled via .strip()).
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_ prefixed restaurant in backend tests. Frontend E2E created TEST_Frontend Trattoria (not cleaned up automatically - safe as test data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py run in ~27s using pytest-xdist. Research endpoint takes ~10-25s due to live Gemini search - use timeout>=90s. SSE format is 'data: {json}\n\n' with types delta/done/error. Continuity test uses a specific number (4271) as canary.
